answer: Mechanism: relic-ridge conductance sampling. Routes must cross a slowly rotated relic set—edges surviving multiple churn epochs and forming a sparse trellis. The signal is boundary conductance between an agent’s neighborhood and this relic trellis: sybil clusters are dense internally but have a thin cut. Attacker cost: provisioning many durable, diverse cross-neighborhood links with real latency/bandwidth over successive epochs; fake density cannot fake the ridge.
